description: The tray popover's own capability set. It is not on the `default` capability because it needs a handful of permissions and none of the rest: granting a window autostart, updater and process:restart it never calls is a wider surface than the popover has any use for. Kept narrow deliberately, and these are what the popover's code actually calls: `listen` for the live security-event feed (AG-578) and the proxy-state event, its cleanup `unlisten`, `hide` for dismissing itself, `opener:allow-open-url` for the menu's Dashboard and Docs items, and `app:allow-version` because `main.tsx` is one entry shared by every window and runs `initAnalytics` in all of them. A window absent from every capability can still invoke application commands, so the popover rendered data and looked healthy while every push it subscribed to was refused: the feed's events never arrived and dismissal silently failed. The opener scope is the two hosts the popover links to rather than `default`'s any-subdomain wildcard, and carries the trailing `/*` that pattern proved necessary.
